response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished software developer with 15+ years of experience, he lacks critical requirements for this embedded security role. Most critically, he has no native-level Japanese language proficiency (a required qualification), only minimal C programming experience (~6 months in 2014-2015), and zero demonstrated expertise in security technologies or networking protocols. His entire career has focused on web, full-stack, and data systems development, with no background in embedded firmware, security engineering, or the LAN-switch domain expertise this position requires.
strengths: Extensive software development experience (15+ years) demonstrating ability to learn diverse technologies and work across multiple domains
Strong engineering practices background including TDD, CI/CD, software craftsmanship, and infrastructure management
Some exposure to embedded systems and hardware interaction through robotics work and infrastructure tooling at Altom Consulting
concerns: No native-level Japanese language proficiency; resume lists only English (Fluent), Romanian (Fluent), and German (Basic)—this is a stated requirement
Severely lacks C programming proficiency required for UNIX embedded development; only ~6 months experience at National Instruments (2014-2015), now 10+ years old
Complete absence of security or networking domain expertise; no mention of encryption, authentication systems, network protocols, LAN switches, or embedded security technologies

key_factors.factor: C programming and embedded firmware experience
